reviewer: sequence-design author; not blind or owner acceptance
review_method: Opened actual PNGs at native resolution; P02/P03 are byte-identical to visually viewed v3. Opened browser-rendered six-image sheet at392px image width. No Python raster editing.

observations.P01: Closed single gate, intact rim crank, both full bodies and four separate tentacle tips are readable. Hand gesture is simplified; generated art must show confidence/open empty hand rather than infer a turn.
observations.P02: Left sleeve traces to10-o-clock rim contact. Right sleeve traces to the intact crank grip. Near forearm crosses the other sleeve but the left fingers remain visible.
observations.P03: Right elbow bends and detached remnant moves leftward/outward and upward to lower chest relative toP02; full remnant and mounted stub have a broad visible gap. Left hand remains on rim.
observations.P04: Both hand centers lie on opposite rim edges. Mara full body and planted sandals fit; part-raised gate and waiting creature are visible. Iven holds the small remnant aside.
observations.P05: Raised gate, downstream creature with four separate tentacle tips, open left-palm shell contact and dry-foot Mara are readable. Mara is close to the right image edge; her raised arm is a simplified blocking reach.
observations.P06: Medium two-shot, opposing eyelines/deadpan brow and raised right-hand remnant are readable. The open gate is composed between the faces instead of the frozen descriptive background-left placement; this guide shifts its background position for readability, not the physical gate state.

limitations: Flat capsule/block figures are mechanism and composition inputs only, not character or style references. Identity/setup sheets govern faces/body/costume in generated art.
Drawn perspective and human poses are approximate, not calibrated projections of metre-based coordinates.
P04 andP05 small remnant is less readable at phone width than the dedicated closeup/payoff; persistence must be checked in actual art.
P05 touch andP06 background placement are simplified staging cues; lead should retain frozen narrative geometry in final exact prompts.
preservation: v1–v3 SVG/PNG versions retained; frozen panel-plan and scene-control unchanged.
